"""Inventory tracking for a small warehouse."""

from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD = 5
DEFAULT_LOCATION = "MAIN"


class InventoryError(Exception):
    """Raised when an operation would leave the inventory invalid."""


@dataclass
class Item:
    sku: str
    name: str
    quantity: int = 0
    location: str = DEFAULT_LOCATION
    tags: set[str] = field(default_factory=set)

    def is_low(self) -> bool:
        return self.quantity <= LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD


@dataclass
class Movement:
    sku: str
    delta: int
    when: date
    reason: str = ""


class Inventory:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._items: dict[str, Item] = {}
        self._history: list[Movement] = []

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self._items)

    def __contains__(self, sku: object) -> bool:
        return sku in self._items

    def add_item(self, item: Item) -> None:
        if item.sku in self._items:
            raise InventoryError(f"duplicate sku {item.sku}")
        if item.quantity < 0:
            raise InventoryError("quantity cannot be negative")
        self._items[item.sku] = item
        log.info("added %s (%s)", item.sku, item.name)

    def get(self, sku: str) -> Item:
        try:
            return self._items[sku]
        except KeyError:
            raise InventoryError(f"unknown sku {sku}") from None

    def adjust(self, sku: str, delta: int, reason: str = "") -> int:
        item = self.get(sku)
        new_quantity = item.quantity + delta
        if new_quantity < 0:
            raise InventoryError(
                f"cannot remove {-delta} of {sku}; only {item.quantity} left"
            )
        item.quantity = new_quantity
        self._history.append(Movement(sku, delta, date.today(), reason))
        return new_quantity

    def low_stock(self) -> list[Item]:
        items = [item for item in self._items.values() if item.is_low()]
        return sorted(items, key=lambda item: (item.quantity, item.sku))

    def by_location(self, location: str) -> list[Item]:
        return [item for item in self._items.values() if item.location == location]

    def history_for(self, sku: str) -> list[Movement]:
        return [move for move in self._history if move.sku == sku]


def load_csv(path: Path) -> Inventory:
    inventory = Inventory()
    with path.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        for row in csv.DictReader(handle):
            tags = {tag.strip() for tag in row.get("tags", "").split(";") if tag.strip()}
            inventory.add_item(
                Item(
                    sku=row["sku"],
                    name=row["name"],
                    quantity=int(row["quantity"]),
                    location=row.get("location") or DEFAULT_LOCATION,
                    tags=tags,
                )
            )
    return inventory


def write_report(inventory: Inventory, path: Path) -> int:
    rows = inventory.low_stock()
    with path.open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        writer = csv.writer(handle)
        writer.writerow(["sku", "name", "quantity", "location"])
        for item in rows:
            writer.writerow([item.sku, item.name, item.quantity, item.location])
    return len(rows)
